Serve a recording over QUIC (signal and views)

```text
dspk serve [OPTIONS] [RECORDING]
```

**Arguments**

- **`[RECORDING]`**  
  Recording every client starts with (any format dspk-io reads); a synthetic one when neither this nor --data is given

**Options**

- **`--data <DATA>`**: env `DSPK_SERVE_DATA`  
  Data root: clients list and open the recordings under it (paths relative to it; hidden files and links out of it are refused)
- **`-b, --bind <BIND>`**: default `127.0.0.1:50051`  
  UDP address to listen on
- **`-v, --verbose`**  
  Show debug logs (runtimes, transport)
- **`--channels <CHANNELS>`**: default `384`  
  Channels of the synthetic recording
- **`--sample-rate <SAMPLE_RATE>`**: default `30000`  
  Sample rate of the synthetic recording (Hz)
- **`--frame-sec <FRAME_SEC>`**: default `0.02`  
  Seconds of signal per frame
- **`--loop`**  
  Start over at the end of the recording
- **`--unpaced`**  
  Send as fast as clients take it, not at the recording's rate
- **`--certificate <CERTIFICATE>`**  
  Certificate chain (PEM); when omitted, the server's authority issues one for the --name names at every start
- **`--private-key <PRIVATE_KEY>`**  
  Private key (PEM) of --certificate
- **`--certificate-out <CERTIFICATE_OUT>`**  
  Where to write the certificate clients trust (DER): the server's authority. Clients enrolled with `dspk clients enroll` have it in their identity file already
- **`--auth-dir <AUTH_DIR>`**: env `DSPK_SERVE_AUTH_DIR`  
  The server's authority folder: its CA and the enrolled clients (default: &lt;data dir>/serve, e.g. ~/.local/share/dspk/serve; created on first use)
- **`--runtime <RUNTIME>`**  
  The compute runtime jobs (sorts) run on: wgpu, cuda, cpu (default: $DSPK_RUNTIME, else the first compiled in, as `dspk doctor` shows)
- **`--allow-anonymous`**  
  Also let in clients without a certificate, read only. Anyone who reaches the port can then read the recording: trusted networks only
- **`--max-clients <MAX_CLIENTS>`**: default `32`  
  Clients connected at once; more are refused until one leaves
- **`--name <NAMES>`**  
  Host names or addresses clients reach the server by, for the self-signed certificate (besides localhost and the --bind address); repeat for several
- **`-h, --help`**  
  Print help
